title: Threat-intel feed coverage — expected vs. ingested batches
summary: Share of scheduled upstream STIX 2.1 / TAXII poll batches that the playbook successfully pulled and normalised into the OCSF Threat Intelligence Inference event class within the evaluation window. A direct measure of how reliably the operator is seeing the upstream feed that downstream detection and blocklist activation depend on. Higher is better.

target.rationale: Coverage floor below which downstream MTTD degrades materially; aligned with ENISA EU CSIRTs network operational guidance on intel-sharing pipeline availability.

measurement.formula: 100 * count(scheduled batches with at least one normalised threat-intel-inference record emitted) / count(scheduled batches) over window.

inputs.name: events
inputs.description: OCSF threat-intel-inference event time, bucketed against the schedule

inputs.name: playbook_run
inputs.description: scheduled feed-pull invocations of the upstream-ingest step

external_refs.name: ENISA — EU CSIRTs network operational guidance
